summary.whatChanges: Adds a `maxBatchSize` option to tRPC server handler options. When a batched HTTP request contains more calls than the limit, it is rejected with a `BAD_REQUEST` error ("Batch call exceeds maximum size"). Docs move the batch-limit recipe from context to the httpBatchLink page; tests updated.
behaviorChanges: Server adapters accept a new optional `maxBatchSize` handler option (default unlimited).
Batch requests exceeding `maxBatchSize` fail with a 400 BAD_REQUEST error and message 'Batch call exceeds maximum size' before procedures run.
Docs now recommend `maxBatchSize` on the server plus matching `maxItems` on httpBatchLink, and the context-based batch-limiting recipe is removed.
risks: The limit is enforced only in the JSON content-type handler's parse path; other content types (e.g. form-data/octet-stream) are unaffected.
Rejection uses BAD_REQUEST (400) rather than TOO_MANY_REQUESTS (429), so clients matching on the old error code from the documented recipe will see a different code.
The whole batch fails at parse time, so no individual calls resolve when the limit is exceeded.
